svg.aria-label: SmolVLA during one control step. Camera images, the instruction and the joint readings go into a 16-layer vision-language model, which runs once. The 16-layer action expert then runs 10 refinement steps, from random noise to 50 planned movements, and reads the vision-language context at every step. The probe reads, and the edit writes, at one place: after layer 4 of the action expert, in the first refinement step, averaged over the 50 movement tokens. Four other measured places are marked in grey.
svg.text: Where the probe reads and the edit writes
SmolVLA during one control step. Rows are layers, columns are refinement steps.
